reason: To establish which bindings are observed at runtime: please describe all consumer groups on Redpanda (rpk group list; rpk group describe <each group>), including members, the topics/partitions each group is attached to, committed offsets and lag.

The docs and READMEs say the product query service builds its read model from catalog Kafka events. I need its consumer configuration (topics, group ids, offset reset) to confirm which catalog topics it consumes across the new boundary.

The category query service is described as the CQRS read model for categories. I need its consumer configuration to confirm which catalog topics (catalog.category.events, maybe catalog.attribute.events or others) it consumes.

The tenant service produces tenant.tenant.events, which the catalog and image services consume (inbound). I need to confirm it is the only producer, and check whether it consumes or produces any catalog.* topic.

Please send the deployed Kafka settings from the platform repository ecommerce-infrastructure/environments/local/values/ for ecommerce-catalog-service and ecommerce-image-service (and, for comparison, the product-query, category-query and tenant services): the kafka.brokers value, every kafka.consumers-config entry (name, topic, group-id, auto-offset-reset, enable-dlq, dlq-topic), and the file paths/line numbers. The values are not in my workspace and the source configs only cover standalone/e2e.

Please list the topics on Redpanda with their configuration (rpk topic list; rpk topic describe <topic> for each catalog.*, tenant.*, *.dlq topic): partitions, replication factor, cleanup.policy, retention, and the current high-water marks. I need this to create matching topics on Kafka and to size the mirror. Also confirm that the Kafka container is still empty (kafka-topics.sh --list against localhost:19092).
